List all configuration values

## Synopsis

```text
Lists all configuration values from the project config (when a project is detected) over the global config file, in the specified style.
```

```text
finfocus config list [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # List all configuration (default YAML style)
  finfocus config list

  # List configuration in JSON style
  finfocus config list --as json

  # --format json (the global agent-mode flag) also selects JSON style
  finfocus config list --format json
```

## Options

```text
  -f, --as string           output style (yaml, json) (default "yaml")
  -h, --help[=true|false]   help for list
```
